name: Similar Reference
description: Uses Views to show similar entities based on a shared entity-reference field.
project_description:
Forked from the Similar By Terms , this module uses an entity reference field (rather than the taxonomy index) to count shared references between entities and create a similarity score in a view.

 Back to top 

 Advantages over Similar By Terms 
 
 not restricted to taxonomy term references 
 could be expanded to work for more than just node views 
 
 Back to top 

 Known Limitations 
 
 cannot use multiple Similar by reference contextual filters on the same view 
 only compares entities of the same entity type 
 only compares entities of different bundles if they share the same reference field 
 not designed for Dynamic Entity Reference fields or Entity Reference Revision fields 
 Back to top
